worktree-provision-hook.title: Add worktree-provision.sh hook
worktree-provision-hook.description:
rc-qa surfaced F2: fresh worktrees under .worktrees/<slug> do NOT inherit the main checkout's per-machine untracked files. Two hit us during the rename project:
- .env (LLM API keys) — scripts/debug-run.sh sources $PROJECT_ROOT/.env. Missing → agent hangs silently waiting for LLM responses with no credentials. Root cause of rc-6's S4 smoke-turn hang.
- local.properties (Android SDK path) — gradle needs it. Missing → assembleDebug fails with 'SDK location not found'. rc-6 worker manually `cp ../../local.properties local.properties`.

The orchestrate skill's worktree-create.sh already provides a per-project hook point: it runs `$repo_root/scripts/worktree-provision.sh` (cwd=new worktree) on first worktree creation if the script exists and is executable. We just haven't written one.

Create scripts/worktree-provision.sh that symlinks .env and local.properties from the main checkout into the new worktree. Symlinks (not copies) so any update to main's .env propagates. Add a short note in doc/dev/development.md under a 'Worktrees' subsection explaining the hook and when it fires.

The main checkout's absolute path is derivable from the worktree's own git metadata: `git rev-parse --git-common-dir` returns the common .git dir; parent of that is the main checkout path. Use that instead of hardcoded absolute paths so the script works on any machine.
acceptCriteria: git diff --name-only HEAD~0 | sort -u | grep -v -E '^(scripts/worktree-provision\.sh|doc/dev/development\.md)$' | grep . && exit 1 || true
worktree-provision-hook.note: Commit e83a8302. scripts/worktree-provision.sh (executable, idempotent, symlinks .env + local.properties from main via git rev-parse --git-common-dir). doc/dev/development.md gained a Worktrees section pointing at the hook. Smoke-tested with throwaway worktree before commit.
